note: Real official NBA injury report layouts behind the nba_injury_sync DRIFT alerts of 2026-10-28/29 (supabase nba_injury_alerts, code report_unread_lines). lines: the PDF read by poppler pdftotext -bbox, adjacent words on one baseline joined into one pdf.js-like text item, then nbaLinesFromItems(items, 2) per page. This reproduces production exactly: the old parser read the same row counts and the same single unread line as the production runs. expect.reasons: each named row's reason assigned independently by geometry (the reason line nearest the row on its page; a line above a page's first row and far from it belongs to the previous page's last row).
